get.summary: Lists shares in the specified workspace.
get.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Share item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [pagination](/rest/api/fabric/articles/pagination).

## Permissions

The caller must have a *viewer* workspace role.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Workspace.Read.All or Workspace.ReadWrite.All

## Microsoft Entra supported identities

This API supports the Microsoft [identities](/rest/api/fabric/articles/identity-support) listed in this section.

| Identity | Support |
|-|-|
| User | Yes |
| [Service principal](/entra/identity-platform/app-objects-and-service-principals#service-principal-object) and [Managed identities](/entra/identity/managed-identities-azure-resources/overview) | Yes |

## Interface

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Lists items in a folder and its nested folders, or just a folder only. True - All items in the folder and its nested folders are listed, False - Only items in the folder are listed. The default value is true.

parameters.name: rootFolderId
parameters.description: This parameter allows users to filter items based on a specific root folder. If not provided, the workspace is used as the root folder.

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results.

429.description: The service rate limit was exceeded. The server returns a `Retry-After` header indicating, in seconds, how long the client must wait before sending additional requests.

Retry-After.description: The number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

default.description:
Common error codes:

* InvalidItemType - The item type is invalid.

post.summary: Creates a share in the specified workspace.
post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Share item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation) when a public definition is supplied.

## Permissions

The caller must have a *contributor* workspace role.

## Required Delegated Scopes

## Limitations

- To create a share, the workspace must be on a supported Fabric capacity. For more information, see [Microsoft Fabric license types](/fabric/enterprise/licenses#microsoft-fabric-license-types).

post.summary: Gets the specified share public definition.
post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Share item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation).

The public definition contains the share's configured assets, recipients, and policies. Runtime state, including the invitation URL, share status, and share version, isn't included.

## Permissions

The caller must have *read and write* permissions for the share.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

## Limitations

To retrieve the definition of a share item protected by an encrypted sensitivity label, the caller must have sufficient [usage rights](/fabric/enterprise/powerbi/service-security-sensitivity-label-change-enforcement) to remove the label, as configured in [Microsoft Purview](/purview/purview).

post.summary: Overrides the definition for the specified share.
post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Share item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation).

The supplied definition replaces the share's configured assets, recipients, and policies. When `updateMetadata` is true and the definition includes a `.platform` part, the share's item metadata is also updated.

## Permissions

The caller must have *read and write* permissions for the share.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

## Interface

parameters.name: updateMetadata
parameters.description: When set to true and the `.platform` file is provided as part of the definition, the item's metadata is updated using the metadata in the `.platform` file.

* CorruptedPayload - The provided definition payload is malformed or cannot be decoded.

* ShareAssetNotFound - An asset referenced by the definition was not found.

* InvalidShareRecipient - A recipient in the definition is invalid.

* InvalidExpirationDateTime - A definition expiration date and time isn't a future UTC value.
